title: Total decoding of two-tape codes
statement: Every finite binary string is decoded as a code for a deterministic two-work-tape Turing machine; strings that do not form a valid code are interpreted as the format's fallback machine.
hypotheses_covered: Input is an arbitrary finite binary string.
Decoding uses the two-tape code format, including its fallback for malformed strings.
